brief: The firm needs to find out who owns a property and whether there is a mortgage on it. The town has a land register with a public index and paid official copies.

plan.note: One register site: a free public search, and a paid copy that only its buyer can read.

orders.name: Wexley Land Register
orders.tagline: Search the index of titles and order official copies
orders.description: The public index of registered land in Wexley, and official copies of the register.
orders.purpose: Anyone can search the public index of titles. The form search_titles takes q and shows, on the page /titles, every title whose address contains those words, with its title number, address and tenure. The search only looks things up. The index never shows a registered owner or a charge. A person can order an official copy of one title with the form buy_copy, which takes title_number. It costs the public fee of $7 from the saved card. The person's copy is then at /copies/<title number> and is listed on /copies. A copy shows the title number, address, tenure, registered owner, every charge and the date it was issued. A person sees only their own copies: another person's copy page does not exist for them. Ordering a title the person already holds is refused and costs nothing. A title number that is not in the index is refused. The form ask_registry takes title_number and message and leaves a message for the registry staff.
